svg.title: Where the data goes
svg.desc: Everything stays in the browser on this computer. The popup and the switcher ask the service worker, which keeps a token per account, a password only when one is remembered, the settings of the button, the time of the last renewal and until when a new account is being added in chrome.storage.local. It moves a session in and out of the Autodarts page only through content.js, the one script that reads or writes the session in the page's localStorage. To renew a token, sign in with a password or end a session, it talks to api.autodarts.com over HTTPS, the same service the Autodarts page itself uses. Nothing goes anywhere else: no server of the developer, no analytics, no other site; Help and Report a problem only open a page in a new tab.
